Objective: Adrian signs the emergency-intervention authorization, completing his enrollment in the experimental-medicine program and securing his financial lifeline, while confronting the final bureaucratic hurdle of the trial.
IntendedChange: Adrian signs the emergency-intervention authorization, completing his enrollment in the experimental-medicine program and securing his financial lifeline, while confronting the final bureaucratic hurdle of the trial.

Scenes.Purpose: Adrian arrives at the clinic for his daily appointment, physically struggling with the medication's side effects (tremors, hyperesthesia) while maintaining his facade of compliance, and waits in the sterile environment for Dr. Thorne to call him in.
Scenes.IntendedChange: Adrian is seated in the waiting area, physically exhausted and hiding his distress, ready to enter the examination room.

Scenes.Purpose: Dr. Thorne presents the emergency-intervention authorization as a mandatory final step for enrollment, explaining the specific loss of bodily autonomy required (override of consent in life-threatening situations) while maintaining strict clinical detachment.
Scenes.IntendedChange: Adrian has read the document and understands the full scope of the waiver, facing the choice to sign or forfeit his financial lifeline.

Scenes.Purpose: Adrian signs the authorization, demonstrating his complete commitment to the trial and his willingness to surrender control over his body in an emergency to secure his survival, after which Thorne processes the final intake payment.
Scenes.IntendedChange: Adrian has signed the document and received confirmation of the final payment, completing his enrollment in the experimental-medicine program.
